title: Fruit of the Spirit
definition: The fruit of the Spirit is the Christlike character produced in believers by the Holy Spirit as they walk by faith and yield to God.
summary: Fruit is not manufactured by human willpower. It grows as the believer abides in Christ, walks by the Spirit, and is transformed into the likeness of Jesus.
christFocus: The fruit of the Spirit shows the life of Christ being formed in His people. It is evidence of grace, not a ground of acceptance before God.

studySections.heading: Doctrine in Summary
studySections.content: Fruit is singular in source: the Spirit produces Christlike life.

studySections.heading: Why This Matters
studySections.content: Fruit stands in contrast to the works of the flesh.

studySections.heading: Discipleship and Application
studySections.content: Growth in fruit calls for surrender, abiding, repentance, and dependence on Christ.
